title: A Computational Implementation of a Goal-Directed Theory of Affect
abstract: arXiv:2609.06654v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Computational modeling of emotion has long faced a tension between descriptive, "snapshot-based" appraisal models and granular, signal-driven architectures that often lack appropriate psychological grounding. This paper addresses this gap by presenting the first high-fidelity computational implementation of the Goal-Directed Theory (GDT) of affect. In this framework, affect is not a post-hoc label but a functional byproduct emerging from the continuous interplay between discrepancy detection and action selection within an agent's internal processing cycles. We evaluate the model through a series of principled simulations (Dice/Corridor tasks) designed to isolate affective signatures and dynamics during multi-step goal pursuit. translated_title: 目标导向情感理论的计算实现
translated_abstract: 情感的计算建模长期以来面临着描述性的“快照式”评估模型与细粒度的信号驱动架构之间的张力，后者往往缺乏恰当的心理学基础。本文通过首次高保真地实现情感的目标导向理论（GDT）的计算模型来弥补这一空白。在该框架中，情感不是一种事后标签，而是从智能体内部处理循环中偏差检测与动作选择之间持续交互涌现出的功能性副产品。我们通过一系列旨在隔离多步骤目标追求过程中的情感特征和动态的原则性仿真实验（骰子/走廊任务）来评估该模型。结果表明，复杂的情感特征，如预期性的“提升”和失败后的“崩溃”，能从目标偏差与动作选择期望之间的简单交互中自然涌现，而无需……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文首次高保真地实现了情感的目标导向理论（GDT）计算模型，证明预期“提升”与失败“崩溃”等复杂情感特征能从目标偏差检测和动作选择期望的简单交互中自然涌现。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first high-fidelity computational implementation of the Goal-Directed Theory (GDT) of affect, demonstrating that complex affective profiles like anticipatory "lift" and failure "crash" emerge naturally from simple interactions between goal-discrepancy detection and action-selection expectancies.
